name: codex-toolkit
description: Delegate to the local Codex CLI from a coding agent: discuss / review / implement code, generate visual assets, review UI screenshots, and check the Codex setup.

interface.shortDescription: Discuss, review, implement, make assets, review screenshots via Codex CLI
interface.longDescription: Four skills sharing one contract: codex (discuss / review / implement against a repository), codex-assets (staged image and vector asset production with a verified manifest), codex-visual-review (read-only screenshot critique, compare, recheck), and codex-setup (readiness report). Model and service tier are always passed explicitly; GPT-6 and fast mode require an explicit user request.
defaultPrompt: Use codex to review my uncommitted changes.
Use codex-assets to make a hero illustration for the README.
Use codex-setup doctor to check my Codex install.
